_comment: Repos that neither infra-config config/repos.toml nor gate settings/github.toml names, with their group. Products and infra repos come from those registries, never from here.

repos.euler: a local workspace that runs Innernet, Quitter and Instants together
repos.quitter: an agent and thread activity prototype

repos.research: research topics, including the interactive infra map
repos.wiki: a bot-generated map of every public repo, regenerated daily

repos.setup: plans qq setup for an org or a machine; this version only reads
repos.agent-skills: skills that let an agent do a whole job from one prompt
